info.title: Gaza Gateway MVP site and contact authority

PassengerCookieAuth.name: gza_session
PassengerCookieAuth.description: Host-only HTTP-only Secure cookie for passenger account realm (Path=/api/v1)

StaffCookieAuth.name: gza_staff_session
StaffCookieAuth.description: Host-only HTTP-only Secure cookie for staff administration realm (Path=/api/v1)

BookingGuestGrantAuth.name: X-Booking-Token
BookingGuestGrantAuth.description: Short-lived (15 min) opaque token issued after successful contact-channel OTP verification, bound strictly to a single booking PNR

WebhookSignatureAuth.name: X-Signature
WebhookSignatureAuth.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated over raw request payload using configured payment provider secret

StaffPreAuthCookieAuth.name: gza_staff_pending
StaffPreAuthCookieAuth.description: Host-only HTTP-only Secure cookie for pending staff MFA / enrollment authority (Path=/api/v1, Max-Age=300)

BookingReceiptGrantAuth.name: X-Booking-Receipt
BookingReceiptGrantAuth.description: Short-lived (10 min) opaque token issued at booking creation, bound strictly to a single booking PNR for minimal receipt retrieval
